title: Lightly Spicy Norwegian Oat Porridge
description: A hearty and nutritious post-workout dish featuring porridge oats and a blend of spices, perfect for a cold morning. This low-glycemic-friendly recipe is made with namul-blanch-seasoned ingredients for added flavor.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Add the porridge oats, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
While the oats are cooking, blanch the namul in boiling water for 30 seconds, then season with a pinch of salt.
Stir the namul and honey into the oat mixture, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the almond milk.
Let the porridge cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the porridge hot, garnished with additional namul if desired.
